7	list, read, write, edit and check. Writes are confined to the checkout and refused on the goal's
8	tests and the toolchain; check runs the checkout's tests in a container with no network and the
9	checkout mounted read-only, so code the model writes never runs on the host and cannot reach the
10	key. The loop is pydantic-ai, pinned; the provider is DeepSeek's chat completions API, the key
11	read from ~/.config/factory/deepseek.key and never written anywhere. Each run leaves
12	runs/<utc-stamp>/ under the factory itself, never in the checkout, with goal.txt, wire.jsonl

121	    for heading, field in SECTIONS:
122	        out.append(f"## {heading}")

124	        if isinstance(items, str):  # check is one value, and renders as one bullet
125	            items = [items]

131	class Tools:
132	    """The tools: what the model can do to the checkout, and the record of it."""
133	
134	    def __init__(self, root: Path, run_dir: Path, hidden: tuple[str, ...] = HIDDEN,
135	                 protected: tuple[str, ...] = PROTECTED, sandbox: Any = None):  # fmt: skip
136	        self.root = root.resolve()
137	        self.run_dir = run_dir
138	        self.hidden = hidden
139	        self.protected = protected
140	        self.sandbox = sandbox
141	        self.listed: list[str] = []
142	        self.read_paths: list[str] = []
143	        self.lines_read = 0
144	        self.written: list[str] = []
145	        self.edited: list[str] = []
146	        self.checks: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
147	
148	    def _resolve(self, path: str) -> tuple[Path, str]:
149	        p = (self.root / (path or ".")).resolve()
150	        if p != self.root and self.root not in p.parents:
151	            raise ValueError(f"outside the checkout: {path}")
152	        rel = p.relative_to(self.root).as_posix() or "."
153	        parts = rel.split("/")
154	        # A .git component at any depth is git's, not the checkout's: a write there could forge a

162	        """The goal's tests and the toolchain are the human's; the builder may read them only."""

172	                hit = rel == pattern

180	        if len(self.written) + len(self.edited) >= WRITE_CAP:
181	            return f"error: cap reached ({WRITE_CAP} writes and edits); report now"

184	    def list(self, path: str = ".") -> str:
185	        """List one directory of the checkout: one entry per line as kind, size, name. Path is the

202	                name = e.name if rel == "." else f"{rel}/{e.name}"  # paths from the checkout root

204	            if len(entries) > LIST_CAP:

211	    def read(self, path: str, start: int = 1) -> str:

213	        lines or 32000 bytes per call; a truncated read says where to continue.
